text:
pagerbot: 🔔 PagerDuty: HIGH - inference-gateway error-rate spike (5xx) - firing
pagerbot: alert: inference-gateway.usw2.error_rate > 5% for 2m (current 12.3%) - links: https://monitoring.redwood/example/alerts/12345 

alice wang: acked — oncall (USW2) grabbing this. Paging rotation: I'm primary for the next 30.
alice wang: quick check — is this entire gateway or a subset of routes?

bob martinez: seeing similar in eu-west logs. looks like keepalive / upstream 502s spiking. not all models; heavy on text-generation endpoints.

alice wang: thanks. pulling the dashboard. visible: 502/504 dominant, spike started ~1712348700, amplification around 1712348800. request rate steady.

charlie ng: infra-bot — any automated scaling or recent deploys?

infra-bot: Deploybot: No deploys in the last 6 hours. Autoscaler: cluster autoscale triggered +2 nodes at 1712348600, not correlated. KV-cache eviction alarm: triggered at 1712348780.

alice wang: interesting — KV-cache eviction could explain cold starts and upstream retries. can someone paste a sample error from the edge?

bob martinez: logs snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T02:34:22Z inference-proxy[proxy-12]: upstream "model-pool-3" returned 502: downstream 0 bytes
2026-03-15T02:34:23Z inference-proxy[proxy-12]: retrying request, attempt=1 route=/v1/generate
2026-03-15T02:34:24Z inference-proxy[proxy-12]: upstream "model-pool-3" timeout after 12s
```

alice wang: ok. model-pool-3 is in dedicated cluster A in usw2. can infra confirm health of that pool?

charlie ng: jumping in — I'm taking handoff in 10m. alice, can you temp route traffic away from model-pool-3 to pool-4/canary while we triage? runbook suggests failing to pool-4 first.

alice wang: doing it now. command: 
```
kubectl patch svc inference-router -n prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/trafficPolicy/pools","value":["pool-1","pool-4"]}]'
```
alice wang: patched, rolling route change in progress. pinging health check.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by alice wang (oncall).

dawn k.: Support: we're seeing ~45 customer errors in the last 5m, highest in USW2 and EU. ETA to customers page: rolling — creating incident tickets and flagging top 10 affected orgs. link to status page draft: https://status.redwood/incident/xxxxx

bob martinez: after routing to pool-4, 5xx rate dropped to ~3.2% from 12.3%. still above threshold but improving. looks like pool-3 has networking flakiness.

charlie ng: good. starting pool-3 node-level diagnostics: cpu/mem fine, but multiple sidecar restarts and socket errors. suspect ephemeral kernel OOM? pulling `dmesg` now.

alice wang: putting short mitigation plan: 1) continue traffic reroute to pool-4 2) drain pool-3 nodes and restart inference service 3) if errors persist, scale pool-4 by +20% 4) follow up postmortem. anyone object?

bob martinez: +1. recommend also temporarily increasing keepalive timeout to reduce upstream resets while nodes recover. config snippet: 
```
route_config:
  upstream_keepalive: 90s
```

charlie ng: applying keepalive change on proxy layer now. patch applied.

infra-bot: Action: draining node node-3a in pool-3; pod eviction started at 1712349000.

alice wang: continuing to monitor metrics. slow tail of errors continuing but trending down.

dawn k.: updated support tickets and messaged top 5 customers — have them on watch, support channel open.

bob martinez: after drain and service restart on pool-3, node sidecars look stable, socket errors gone. 5xx rate back down to 0.9% across services.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: auto-escalation suppressed (incident acknowledged).

charlie ng: handing back to alice (oncall passes back). I'll continue background checks and will join postmortem.

alice wang: thanks charlie. re-enabling pool-3 traffic gradually. command: 
```
kubectl patch svc inference-router -n prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/trafficPolicy/pools","value":["pool-1","pool-4","pool-3"]}]'
```
alice wang: re-add at 10% to start, observing.

bob martinez: traffic reintroduce looks healthy, no spike. full route at 1712349180. final 5xx rate 0.3% last 5m.

dawn k.: Support: all open customer tickets updated. no escalations requested. keeping on watch for 2 hours.

alice wang: summary for incident notes: root cause: transient model-pool-sidecar network errors causing upstream 502s amplified by KV-cache eviction causing cold requests. mitigation: traffic reroute to pool-4, drain+restart pool-3, increase keepalive to reduce resets. impact: brief ~12% 5xx spike between 1712348780-1712349000; customer-visible errors ~45 incidents, top orgs contacted.

alice wang: next steps: 1) infra to add alert for repeated sidecar restarts in pool 2) ops to review KV-cache eviction thresholds 3) runbook: add explicit step to check pool sidecars before autoscale.

charlie ng: will own infra action. filing ticket INFRA-3402.

bob martinez: I'll take the ops/KV-cache ticket. OPS-2119.

dawn k.: support will run a customer impact audit and collate messages for legal if needed.

alice wang: closing the pager. monitoring window continues 2h. will open postmortem doc later today.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: resolved (incident closed) at 1712349245.

alice wang: thanks everyone — great quick coordination. :thumbsup:

charlie ng: +1, nice work.

bob martinez: filing notes to the incident doc now.

pagerbot: Note: follow-up required: runbook update, alert tuning, KV-cache thresholds.
